before_en:
Compare what happens to the white pawn originally on e5 in the recorded f6 and Rac8 lines.

f6 attacks White's pawn on e5; exf6 moves that piece out of the attack. exf6 moves the pawn out of the attacks from Black's knight on c6 and Black's pawn on f6. After Ne5, White's knight on e5 now targets Black's knight on c6. With Nxe5, the black knight originally on c6 captures the attacking white knight originally on f3. dxe5 moves the pawn out of the attack from Black's queen on b6. With dxe5, the white pawn originally on d4 recaptures the black knight originally on c6.

After Rac8, Black's rook on c8 adds support to Black's knight on c6. The recorded continuation is Qd2. Na7 leaves Black's bishop on d7 attacking White's knight on b5; Nxa7 moves that piece out of the attack. Nxa7 … Qxa7: 1 pair of knights is exchanged. Black's original b6 queen recaptures on a7. After Rxe7, the white pawn originally on e5 is still present on e5.

The compared root choices are f6 and Rac8.

f6 clears f7; later Rxf6 passes through that square in this line. After Rxf6, Black's rook on f6 now targets White's pawn on f4.

In the f6 line: exf6 captures the black pawn on f6. Rxf6 recaptures the white pawn on f6.

after_en:
Rac8 — Places the rook on the open c-file. f6 — Newly attacks White's pawn on e5. f6 clears f7; later Rxf6: Black's rook on f6 passes through that square in this line.  Rac8 through its checkpoint: 1 pair of knights is exchanged. f6 through its checkpoint: 1 pair of pawns is exchanged. In the Rac8 line: Na7 leaves Black's bishop on d7 attacking White's knight on b5; Nxa7 moves that piece out of the attack.

Rac8 — after Qd2: newly attacks Black's knight on b4. Qxa7: in this continuation, Black's rook on c8 works on the open c-file. The original e5 pawn remains on e5. This continuation retains Black's pawn on f7.

f6 — after exf6: captures Black's pawn on f6. Be8: in this continuation, Black's rook on f6 attacks White's pawn on f4. Black's rook on a8 and Black's knight on c6 remain.
after_ko:
Rac8 — 룩을 열린 c 파일에 배치합니다. f6 — 백 e5 폰을 새로 공격합니다. f6 수로 f7 칸을 비워 길을 엽니다. 제시된 수순에서 Rxf6 수로 흑 룩이 그 길을 지나 f6에 진출합니다.  Rac8 수순의 비교 시점까지 나이트 한 쌍을 교환합니다. f6 수순의 비교 시점까지 폰 한 쌍을 교환합니다. Rac8 수순에서: Na7 뒤 흑 d7 비숍이 백 b5 나이트를 공격하지만, Nxa7 수로 피합니다.

Rac8 — Qd2: 흑 b4 나이트를 새로 공격합니다. Qxa7까지의 수순에서는 흑 c8 룩은 열린 c 파일에서 활동합니다. 원래 e5 폰이 e5에 남습니다. 흑 f7 폰을 남깁니다.

f6 — exf6: 흑 f6 폰을 잡습니다. Be8까지의 수순에서는 흑 f6 룩은 백 f4 폰을 공격합니다. 흑 a8 룩, 흑 c6 나이트를 남깁니다.
